sources: Yahya Saree, Ansar Allah military spokesman, via Gulf News liveblog (22:25 ) and Khaleej Times (AFP)
fault_line: Were the missiles aimed at the holy cities, or did interception debris merely fall there while the targets were oil/airport sites? — the answer decides whether the Ansar Allah broke their own Mecca/Medina exemption.

sections.what_happened: Ansar Allah military spokesman Yahya Saree denied that Ansar Allah forces targeted Mecca and Medina: 'What the Saudi enemy is promoting about our forces targeting towards the holy areas of Mecca and Medina is a great and huge lie.' The denial follows Saudi Civil Defence's Saturday statement that debris from two intercepted Ansar Allah ballistic missiles fell in Mecca (Wadi al-Mughammas), Jeddah, Taif and Rabigh. Label: the DENIAL is a PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM (confirmed as made); whether any missile was aimed at the holy cities themselves is CONTESTED — Saudi Arabia says the missiles headed toward the Mecca and Medina regions; the Ansar Allah say their targets were oil facilities, airports and bases, and that Mecca/Medina airspace was exempted in their 19 October statement.
sections.what_verified: Denial carried by Gulf News liveblog and by Khaleej Times citing AFP — 2 distinct publisher families
sections.what_disputed: Saudi Civil Defence statement (totw-20261024-2200-01): debris from two intercepted missiles fell in Wadi al-Mughammas in Mecca itself, plus Jeddah, Taif and Rabigh; Saudi statement says missiles headed toward the Mecca and Medina regions. Khaleej Times notes precedent: Saudi reported a Ansar Allah drone south of Makkah on 24 September and a Taibah electricity station attack in Madinah on 29 September, both previously denied by the Ansar Allah.
sections.why_matters: Both sides agree missiles flew over western Saudi Arabia on Saturday. They disagree on the one thing that matters most to a billion Muslims: were Mecca and Medina the target? The denial, the debris map, and the Ansar Allah' own 19 October exemption, side by side.
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (in-window, Sat Oct 24 evening) -- Ansar Allah deny targeting Mecca and Medina after Saudi Civil Defence reports missile debris in the holy-city regions

totw_analysis: Our read: Both sides agree missiles flew over western Saudi Arabia on Saturday. They disagree on the one thing that matters most to a billion Muslims: were Mecca and Medina the target? The denial, the debris map, and the Ansar Allah' own 19 October exemption, side by side. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Were the missiles aimed at the holy cities, or did interception debris merely fall there while the targets were oil/airport sites? — the answer decides whether the Ansar Allah broke their own Mecca/Medina exemption.
